description: DIRECTIONAL_CORRESPONDENCE_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md: candidate bridge 2 (REASONING_FACILITY_BRIDGE_RESULTS.md Sec3), built. `_pair_witness`'s own {shared, name_shared, fixed_count, transform} is SYMMETRIC by construction and carries no directional signal -- confirmed by that rung, not re-litigated here. This seed adds a genuinely asymmetric signal (structural-elaboration richness: how many axes of the SAME shape_vocabulary each concept in a pair is independently evidenced on, `sum(1 for _,v in vec if v != _ABSENT)` -- a plain arithmetic reduction over an already-computed vector, the SAME idiom `analogical_thinking._pair_witness`'s own `name_shared` count already uses, not a new judgement engine) and a NEW node type, `DirectionalCorrespondence`, to carry the direction verdict. `DirectionalCorrespondence` is DELIBERATELY NOT a `ShapeSignature`: runners/dsl/src/shape_decode.rs::load_parts loads EVERY `ShapeSignature` node with a name+signature attr into the live ShapeDecode codebook pool regardless of its `kind` attr (kind is read but never used to filter) -- confirmed by reading that function before writing this seed -- so an unverified hypothesis tagged ShapeSignature{kind:...} would be silently live in real deduction the moment its `signature` shape matched a real gap, no matter what `kind` said. The only genuinely safe gate is a node-TYPE boundary. Promotion into a real `ShapeSignature{kind:knowledge_logical}` (where it DOES become live, at the elaborative coherence tier) is a separate, explicit, never-automatic step -- domains/propositional_deduction.py::mint_logical_schema_from_analogy -- which is why this seed also adds ONE production for that promoted schema's own `derived_from` edge back to the DirectionalCorrespondence node it was promoted from (for inspectable provenance, distinguishing an analogically-derived schema from a directly-taught one).

microtheory.name: directional_correspondence
microtheory.description: a directional correspondence resolves to a_source (concept A is structurally richer), b_source (concept B is), symmetric (tied richness -- direction genuinely underdetermined, never forced), or no_correspondence (no shared structure at all) -- tick-driven, no Python decision.

rules.name: direction_a_source
rules.comment: A pending DirectionalCorrespondence whose two sides carry structural correspondence (shared_count>0) and whose 'a' side is STRICTLY richer (evidenced on more axes of the same shape vocabulary) than its 'b' side resolves a_source: the richer, better-elaborated concept supplies the hypothesis, the sparser one receives it -- the standard analogy-theory reading (a richer base domain explains a sparser target domain) applied to a quantity ALREADY computed per-side by the caller, never invented here. The JUDGEMENT (which count is bigger) is this Gt comparison, made by the engine over two already-written attrs -- never a Python if/else.

rules.name: direction_b_source
rules.comment: Symmetric to direction_a_source: the 'b' side is strictly richer -- it supplies the hypothesis, 'a' receives it.

rules.name: direction_symmetric
rules.comment: Real structural correspondence exists (shared_count>0) but the two sides are EQUALLY rich -- direction is genuinely underdetermined by this signal, and no direction is forced. No source_concept/target_concept edge is written; the honest non-answer, mirroring _finalise_analogy's own 'a claim that is neither aligned nor corroborated is None' ethos one grain over.

rules.name: direction_no_correspondence
rules.comment: TERMINAL, fixpoint hygiene only (mirrors blob_no_collapse): no shared structure at all (shared_count<=0) -- the direction question does not even arise. Recorded as a definite status, never left pending forever and never forced into a direction.
